title: Asia Helps Ralph Lauren Grow Faster

source.outlet: Ralph Lauren Corporation (press release filed with the SEC, Business Wire)
source.author: Ralph Lauren Corporation
source.title: Ralph Lauren Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results Ahead of Expectations and Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook
source.checked_against: Primary source (the company's own release as filed with the SEC). Web search on 2026-11-06 found no independent news coverage of the Q2 FY2027 results yet; search results only showed the same SEC filing (net income $297M, $4.87 EPS, $4.64 adjusted, inventory $1.2B down 9%), consistent with the release. No figure taken from any other source.

figures.text: results ahead of expectations, outlook raised
figures.quote: RALPH LAUREN REPORTS SECOND QUARTER FISCAL 2027 RESULTS AHEAD OF EXPECTATIONS AND RAISES FISCAL 2027 OUTLOOK

figures.text: revenue +9% to $2.2 billion reported, +10% constant currency
figures.quote: revenue increased 9% to $2.2 billion on a reported basis and was up 10% in constant currency.
Asia revenue in the second quarter increased 28% to $571 million on a reported basis.
China revenue increased more than 35% on both a reported and constant currency basis
North America revenue in the second quarter increased 6% to $885 million on a reported basis.

figures.text: Europe revenue +1% to $696 million reported, +3% constant currency
figures.quote: Europe revenue in the second quarter increased 1% to $696 million on a reported basis. ... In constant currency, revenue increased 3%.

figures.text: average unit retail +9% across direct-to-consumer, strong full-price selling
figures.quote: Increased AUR by 9% across our direct-to-consumer network in the second quarter, above expectations, reflecting our continued elevation and strong full-price selling trends

figures.text: reported gross margin 74.2%, driven by tariff refunds
figures.quote: gross margin was 74.2%, 620 basis points above the prior year. ... primarily driven by tariff refunds received in the quarter.

figures.text: adjusted gross margin 70.5%, +250 bp (2.5 percentage points)
figures.quote: On an adjusted basis, ... gross margin was 70.5%, 250 basis points above the prior year.

figures.text: adjusted operating margin 15.7%, +160 bp (1.6 percentage points)
figures.quote: On an adjusted basis, operating income was $345 million and operating margin was 15.7%, 160 basis points above the prior year.
Net income in the second quarter of Fiscal 2027 was $297 million, or $4.87 per diluted share on a reported basis.

figures.text: inventory $1.2 billion, down 9% from a year earlier
figures.quote: Inventory at the end of the second quarter of Fiscal 2027 was $1.2 billion, down 9% compared to the prior year period.

figures.text: full-year constant-currency revenue growth now about 6%-7%, up from 5%-6%
figures.quote: now centered around 6% to 7%, up from a range of 5% to 6% previously

figures.text: CEO Patrice Louvet: strong quarter lets company raise outlook once again
figures.quote: "We delivered strong second quarter performance, enabling us to raise our Fiscal 2027 outlook once again," said Patrice Louvet, President and Chief Executive Officer.

figures.text: third quarter revenue growth expected about 3%-4% constant currency
figures.quote: For the third quarter, the Company expects revenues to grow approximately low- to mid-single digits on a constant currency basis, centered around 3% to 4%.

figures.text: higher marketing investments in the holiday period
figures.quote: gross margin expansion more than offsetting higher marketing investments in the holiday period.
